_readme.overview: Triggered by Monday.com status change to 'New'. Fetches item details, pulls clinical docs from DrChrono, sends to Gemini for appeal letter drafting, creates Google Doc, updates Monday.com (status → Drafted, link to doc, move to In Progress group), and sends RingCentral alert.
setup_steps: 1. Import this workflow into your n8n instance
2. Configure Google Cloud credential (Vertex AI + Docs/Drive access)
3. Configure Monday.com HTTP Header Auth credential
4. Configure DrChrono HTTP Header Auth credential (when available)
6. In Monday.com board settings, create a webhook integration that sends to this workflow's URL when Appeal Status changes
